crew.original_title: Barbie as The Princess & the Pauper
crew.overview: In her first animated musical featuring seven original songs, Barbie comes to life in this modern re-telling of a classic tale of mistaken identity and the power of friendship. Based on the story by Mark Twain.
crew.title: Barbie as The Princess & the Pauper

details.biography: Multi-platinum-selling songwriter and composer Megan Cavallari makes music and scores for film, television, theatre, pop artists, commercials, opera, and animation. She has written for 24 television shows and 21 feature films. As a teenager, she studied music under Dr. Alfred Blatter and George Crumb, and has two degrees in music composition and lyric writing from New York University. Megan got her start working as an assistant to Danny Elfman on The Nightmare Before Christmas. She has worked with people and companies ranging from the LA Kings NHL team to Mattel's Barbie to guitar legend Steve Vai. Kevin McCollum (Rent, Avenue Q, In the Heights, Motown) and Richard Kraft are producing a musical written by Megan and lyricist David Goldsmith. Megan lives in Studio City and is an avid ice hockey fan and player (left wing).
details.name: Megan Cavallari
